name: Mizuho (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mizuho city emblem in green: a stylised sheaf of leaves in two shades of green.
history: Municipal flag of Mizuho, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 July 2003.

features.role: Mizuho city emblem — a stylised sheaf of leaves in two shades of green
